# jamfplatform_device (Data Source)

Lookup a Jamf device by ID via the Device Inventory API. Requires **Device Inventory API** access.

**Required Jamf privileges**

The Jamf Platform API integration used by the provider must be granted the following privileges:

| Required privilege |
|---|
| `read:pro:devices` |

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "jamfplatform_device" "example_by_id" {
  id = "12345678-90AB-CDEF-1234-567890ABCDEF"
}

output "device_by_id" {
  value = data.jamfplatform_device.example_by_id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Device UUID (Jamf Pro Management ID) to query.

### Optional

- `timeouts` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `enrollment_type` (String) Enrollment type reported by the API.
- `hardware_battery_health` (String) Battery health reported by inventory.
- `hardware_mac_address` (String) Primary hardware MAC address.
- `hardware_make` (String) Hardware make from the detailed device record.
- `hardware_storage_capacity` (Number) Total storage capacity in bytes.
- `hardware_storage_used` (Number) Used storage in bytes.
- `hardware_udid` (String) Hardware UDID reported by inventory.
- `last_check_in_time` (String) Timestamp of the last check-in in ISO 8601 format.
- `last_enrollment_time` (String) Timestamp of the last enrollment in ISO 8601 format.
- `last_inventory_update_time` (String) Timestamp of the last inventory update in ISO 8601 format.
- `managed` (Boolean) Indicates whether the device is managed.
- `mdm_capable` (Boolean) Indicates whether the device is MDM capable.
- `model` (String) Marketing model string.
- `model_identifier` (String) Model identifier (e.g., Mac14,6).
- `name` (String) Device name reported by inventory.
- `network_last_ip_address` (String) Last IP address reported for the device.
- `network_last_reported_ipv4_address` (String) Last reported IPv4 address.
- `network_last_reported_ipv6_address` (String) Last reported IPv6 address.
- `operating_system_build` (String) Operating system build string.
- `operating_system_name` (String) Operating system name.
- `operating_system_rapid_security_response` (String) Rapid Security Response build identifier, if provided.
- `operating_system_supplemental_build_version` (String) Supplemental build version, if provided.
- `operating_system_version` (String) Operating system version string.
- `security_bootstrap_token_escrowed_status` (String) Bootstrap token escrow status.
- `security_hardware_encryption` (Boolean) Indicates whether hardware encryption is enabled.
- `security_lost_mode_enabled` (Boolean) Indicates whether lost mode is enabled.
- `security_passcode_compliant` (Boolean) Indicates whether the passcode complies with policy.
- `security_passcode_present` (Boolean) Indicates whether a passcode is present.
- `serial_number` (String) Device serial number reported by inventory (case-sensitive).
- `supervised` (Boolean) Indicates whether the device is supervised.
- `user_id` (String) User ID associated with the device, if any.

<a id="nestedatt--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `read` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).
